title: Plus Size Sequin Knit Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Shine bright in this stunning plus-size sequin evening dress! Featuring a figure-flattering knit design, shimmering sequins, and an elegant silhouette, this dress is perfect for glamorous nights, formal events, or any occasion where you want to dazzle.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Fitted sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises knit.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
